paragraphs.source_en:
Time
is endless in thy hands, my lord. There is none to count thy minutes.

units.source_en:
Time
is endless in thy hands, my lord.

ja.t: きることがありません。

units.source_en: There is none to count thy minutes.

paragraphs.source_en: Days and nights pass and ages bloom and fade like flowers. Thou knowest how to wait.

units.source_en: Days and nights pass and ages bloom and fade like flowers.

paragraphs.source_en: Thy centuries follow each other perfecting a small wild flower.

units.source_en: Thy centuries follow each other perfecting a small wild flower.

paragraphs.source_en: We have no time to lose, and having no time we must scramble for our chances. We are too poor to be late.

units.source_en: We have no time to lose, and having no time we must scramble for our chances.
We are too poor to be late.

paragraphs.source_en: And thus it is that time goes by while I give it to every querulous man who claims it, and thine altar is empty of all offerings to the last.

units.source_en: And thus it is that time goes by while I give it to every querulous man who claims it, and thine altar is empty of all offerings to the last.

paragraphs.source_en: At the end of the day I hasten in fear lest thy gate be shut; but I find that yet there is time.

units.source_en: At the end of the day I hasten in fear lest thy gate be shut; but I find that yet there is time.

ja.t: ざされてしまうのではないかと
